doc.title: Frank Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 7, 1998

title: Smooth jazz
summary: Foster describes smooth jazz as light as a feather.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Wow. Well this has really been great, you know I almost feel like somewhere down the line we’ll have to do Part III. You’ve got an awful lot to say, I know you’ve got some well thought out opinions on the current state of music. And just show me — you had a gesture you made when you were talking about smooth jazz as you put it. Do you remember what it was this morning? I think you went —
Oh yeah, it’s light as a feather jazz, you could put it in the palm of your hand and just blow it away.
